create_dual_level: create a forward AD computation context using the dual_level context manager
make_dual_tensor: make a dual tensor by associating a primal tensor with its tangent for forward AD gradient computation
unpack_dual_tensor: unpack a dual tensor to retrieve its primal value and forward AD gradient tangent
enter_exit_dual_level: enter and exit forward AD dual levels to manage gradient computation scope
compute_jvp: compute a jacobian-vector product using dual tensors and unpack_dual to extract the result
